title: desmanthus luteus
intro: Desmanthus luteus, commonly known as Yellowflower Broomweed, is a flowering plant native to China and parts of Southeast Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, providing several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and enhancing the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Desmanthus luteus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
